_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Druid tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull. Forever notes: the druid kit carries forms later Classic-era druids never got (Moonkin Form, Tree of Life, Travel/Aquatic/Dire Bear) and Forever additions in the base kit: Prowl (cat-38 stealth, shares the category with rogue Stealth), Cower, Primal Bite, Shifting Power, Swiftmend, Wild Growth, Nature's Grasp, Savage Roar, Gift of the Wild. There is NO Tiger's Fury, no Innervate-cost change, and Mangle is kept OUT on purpose: its only row in this build (409828) is filed under Family 3 (the Mage family code -- a data quirk, verified 2026-11-01), and the generator never takes a foreign-family row, not even via the uncoded fallback. Rebirth carries a 30-min shared category cooldown (category 26). Some names (Enrage, Growl, Thorns, Lacerate, Cure Poison) collide across families; the generator picks the highest-rank row globally, which is fine for name-keyed cast tracking -- except where a family-less store row of a hunter pet / item proc out-ranks the real druid spell, which is what `_pins` is for (Abolish Poison, Cower, Dash, Thorns). T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1/Q6 rulings): the reference's CAST spells are added -- cooldowns += Skull Bash (the bear stun), Berserk (the druid Berserker CD), Starfall (90 s category), Dash (the Q6 mobility row, now pinned to the druid's own 9821); buffs += Lifebloom, Pounce + Pounce Bleed (the cat opener pair). The reference's proc/passive names for this class -- see _deferred_H7 -- ride with H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md) after the launch-day probes. Wave I-2b (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1/§7.7 + Blizzard dev notes post 9): Berserk PRUNED from [cooldowns] (post 9: 'Berserk talent removed (Primal Bite replaces)'; the client capture still ships the 417141 180 s row -- upstream-data §5 row 16, hotfix-watch); [buffs] += Ferocious Bite (the post-9 new Rank 1 at level 24 -- the pick rides the top rank of the ladder) and Bloom (the new Rejuvenation/Regrowth-expiry heal, 1328621, the store's value row carries a 0 ms window: announce layer, not a bar); the Primal Bite pick moves off the value-less Rank 4 (1238073) to the store's ranked top Rank 3 (1238070) by the new rank law. Wave I-3 H7 (2026-11-03, upstream-data §3.1/§7.3, fx-worker I3e): Clearcasting MOVED OUT of _deferred_H7 into [buffs] -- the wowsims MIT names.json keys druid clearcasting at 16870 and the base row (15000) and the 70707 value row (16870 durationMs 15000, procFlag 87376) agree on a 15 s proc window (upstream-data §3.1 row 1). The kept _deferred_H7 names have no names.json key (§3.1 Unresolvable): Living Seed (base 414680, a 15 s MoP proc), Nature's Grace (16886, 3 s) and Savage Defense (410144, 10 s, uncoded family) ride Classic-era base rows whose 2026-kit keying is a launch-day probe, not MIT name-verified data. In combat a proc window is a sealed aura read: Forte_Timer/Core/Reconcile.lua Gates() (:78-92) runs ZERO aura reads in combat, so the proc row is drawn by the out-of-combat sweep (:300-315) and a sealed read never fabricates a row. Wave B3 (2026-11-10, docs/research/live-druid-2026-11-09.md SS2/SS4/SS5): `_pins` += Abolish Poison 2893 (14253 = Black Husk Shield on-use), Cower 9892 (16697 = hunter pet), Dash 9821 (23110 = hunter pet; the druid Dash is cat-only, 15 s, 300 s category), Thorns 9910 (15438 = item-proc aura); REMOVED the proven non-druid proc rows (high confidence, positive code evidence): Astral Power 467088 (T2 Balance 6P proc), Force of Nature 467079 (T2 Balance 4P summon), Wild Rejuvenation 1226046 (Scarlet Enclave Resto 6P proc), Fury of Stormrage 414800 (talent proc 414799 trigger), Thrash 21919 (Thrash Blade item proc, tracked by Forte_ItemProcs). The medium-confidence rune-era rows (Lifebloom, Skull Bash, Starfall, Sunfire, Savage Roar, Survival Instincts, Tree of Life) stay until the in-game IsSpellKnown probe; Eclipse (a real talent whose aura procs on Wrath hit) joins _deferred_H7.

Berserking.reason: all four 70790 rows (20554/23505/24378/1286304) are value-less name shells (no Cooldowns row), so the bare-row tiebreak rides the arbitrary max-id shell; 20554 is the id measured 180 s on the live client (tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, owner session 2026-11-06; review-10 M2/m4). The druid carries Berserking (Troll) but NOT Rapid Regeneration (a Dwarf racial the druid roster cannot roll)

Abolish Poison.reason: 14253 is the on-use spell of the item Black Husk Shield (no SkillLineAbility; Forte_Items row 4444 already carries it). 2893 is the druid spell (family 7, stance mask 1073741826, sim Ranked(2893), ForeverDB level 26); the family-less store row 14253 joined the in-family pool and won the level tie on id (docs/research/live-druid-2026-11-09.md SS2, SS4)

Cower.reason: 16697 is the Hunter pet's Cower Rank 6 (sim hunter CowerTriggered, pet skill line 270). The druid ladder is 8998/9000/9892 (Cat Form, 10 s cooldown category 84, GCD 1 s); the family-less store row won on level 55 vs 52 (docs/research/live-druid-2026-11-09.md SS4)

Dash.reason: 23110 is the Hunter pet's Dash Rank 3 (sim hunter DashTriggered 23099/23109/23110, pet skill lines, 30 s, GCD 1.5 s). The druid Dash is 1850/9821 (Cat Form, 15 s, category cooldown 300 s, off-GCD; sim Ranked(1850, 9821); ForeverDB level 26). No family-7 Dash row exists, so the family-less pet row won on level 50 vs 46 (docs/research/live-druid-2026-11-09.md SS4)

Thorns.reason: the 70862 store gained value rows for 15438, the item-proc aura (Arcane damage when struck, no family, permanent, level 55), which out-ranks the real Rank 6 ally buff 9910 (family 7, 600 s, level 54) on level (docs/research/data-diff-live-2026-11-10.md SS3.2-3.3)

Berserking.reason: the racial is a self haste buff (+10% attack and cast speed on the caster); the store's four name shells (20554/23505/24378/1286304) carry no Effects/Targets, so the generator cannot derive the feed -- without this the Spell Timer row would be keyed to the current enemy target and retired when it dies (2026-11-14, Berserking not shown on the Spell Timer)
